title: $L^p$-Liouville properties and realizations of Schrödinger operators on incomplete Riemannian manifolds
summary: The aim of the paper is to highlight and standardize in a self-contained framework the connections between some properties associated with the Laplace-Beltrami operator on possibly incomplete Riemannian manifolds. We present both new and well-known characterizations of the positivity-preserving property, essential self-adjointness, and Liouville-type results for $L^2$-functions, using the latter to establish a clear hierarchy among these properties.
